hardGates.name: no_mandatory_payment_or_card
hardGates.rule: The complete normal operating profile must not require a paid subscription, payment method, or credit-card verification.

hardGates.name: no_automatic_paid_overage
hardGates.rule: Quota exhaustion must fail closed without creating a charge or debt.

hardGates.name: durable_internal_scheduler
hardGates.rule: Normal collection requires a durable scheduler capable of one-minute-or-finer internal continuation; GitHub Actions is not the normal collection clock.

hardGates.name: transactional_phase_completion
hardGates.rule: Phase mutation, current-message completion, and successor reservation must share an atomic boundary or a proven equivalent.

hardGates.name: committed_only_reads
hardGates.rule: Uncommitted candidate rows must never become public or shadow-authoritative.

hardGates.name: exact_complete_state_transfer
hardGates.rule: The profile must export and empty-target restore collection, scheduler, publication, and maintenance state into the canonical reference envelope.

hardGates.name: throughput
hardGates.rule: Retained evidence must exceed 21 committed ledgers per minute in steady p95 windows and 30 committed ledgers per minute during catch-up.

hardGates.name: resource_fail_closed
hardGates.rule: The profile must halt before request, query, write, CPU, memory, storage, message, or runtime ceilings and must not advance a cursor after partial work.

hardGates.name: operator_independence
hardGates.rule: Deploy, rollback, checkpoint, restore, and evidence paths must not require routine interactive dashboard or terminal operation.

hardGates.name: production_boundary
hardGates.rule: R4 performs no production mutation, keeps Mainnet disabled, and cannot authorize recovery before R5.

candidates.label: Cardless self-hosted SQLite service

components.scheduler: local durable scheduler and service manager
components.execution: local long-running or frequently awakened process
components.publication: Git-backed immutable publication outside the collection clock

blockingEvidence: No always-on host has been selected or proven.
Power, network, process supervision, unattended restart, secure ingress, and off-host evidence retention are unproven.
Routine operation must not depend on an interactive local terminal.
candidates.nextTest: Build a local service-manager harness and run deterministic resource and restart qualification without any remote mutation.

candidates.label: Supabase Free Postgres plus pg_cron and Edge Functions
blockingEvidence: Free projects may pause after low activity.
The Free database limit and read-only transition require an earlier project stop threshold.
Exact scheduler ownership, transaction semantics, complete-state transfer, WebSocket behavior, and cardless account creation remain unproven.
No paid-plan upgrade or payment-method addition is permitted.
candidates.nextTest: Implement a local Postgres conformance harness first; no Supabase project or credential is required for R4A/R4B.

candidates.label: Turso Free storage with cardless self-hosted executor
blockingEvidence: Turso supplies storage, not the required normal scheduler and execution profile.
Remote transaction behavior across scheduler and storage ownership must pass the same atomic conformance suite.
Free inactive databases may be archived; active-operation and restore behavior require retained evidence.
A second service must not reintroduce a payment method or routine interactive operation.
candidates.nextTest: Implement a transaction and export/restore compatibility harness against a local Turso/libSQL-compatible target before any cloud credential is used.

candidates.label: Existing Cloudflare Workers Free plus D1 and Queues profile

components.scheduler: Queue successor plus optional Cron reseed

blockingEvidence: The current account/profile cannot be used until access and zero-additional-charge operation are independently proven.
No new payment method, paid subscription, or billing assumption is permitted.
The retired production profile already failed a Worker subrequest ceiling.
Workers Free CPU and subrequest limits require measured microphase evidence rather than theoretical fit.
candidates.nextTest: Local adapter conformance and exact resource accounting only; no remote deploy or account mutation.

candidates.label: GitHub Actions as the complete collector runtime
candidates.reason: Scheduled workflows have a five-minute minimum and may be delayed or dropped under load, so Actions cannot own the normal collection clock.
candidates.retainedUse: CI, immutable publication, evidence retention, and bounded repair workflows only.

candidates.label: Deno Deploy Free managed runtime
candidates.reason: Unrestricted Free organization use requires credit-card verification and the current platform provides no uptime guarantee during public beta.
candidates.retainedUse: None for the production collector profile. Self-hosted Deno remains a different local-runtime option, not this managed profile.
